text: and vidyayam vidyesastvastavise sadasive panca vama jyestha raudri saktih sakala ca sontayam astadasa bhuvana syat santyatita tvabhuvanaiva iti desadhvavibhagah kathitah srisambhuna samadistah

snippet: In vidyā are the Vidyeśvaras, and in Īśa there are eight. In Sadāśiva there are five: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Śakti, and Sakalā. This is the peaceful level.
text: in vidya are the vidyesvaras and in isa there are eight in sadasiva there are five vama jyestha raudri sakti and sakala this is the peaceful level vidyayam in knowledge vidyesastvastavise eight lords of knowledge in isa sadasive in sadasiva panca five vama vama jyestha jyestha raudri raudri saktih power sakala sakala ca and sontayam santa

snippet: Śāntyatītā consists of eighteen worlds, yet it is also itself a world. Thus the division of the path of space has been told, as instructed by revered Śambhu.
text: santyatita consists of eighteen worlds yet it is also itself a world thus the division of the path of space has been told as instructed by revered sambhu astadasa eighteen bhuvana worlds syat may be santyatita beyond peace tvabhuvanaiva indeed a world iti thus desadhvavibhagah division of path of space kathitah declared srisambhuna by venerable sambhu samadistah instructed
